description: A ruggedized auxiliary electrical bay built around the vehicle's generator hardware and power conditioning equipment.  The GMV's solar panels, engine alternator, and storage batteries provide its usable electrical supply.
//: Do not add REACTOR here. TLG initializes every spawned vehicle reactor with plut_cell regardless of fuel_type, which makes non-plutonium generator items such as portable_generator/military_generator throw item::ammo_set debug errors when the GMV is spawned.
